name: Singed Red Mitten

clues.text: Smells of woodsmoke and engine soot.
Faded red wool, scorched at the thumb.
Stitched inside the cuff: B.S.

story: Bram presses it to his chest. "Forty winters of shoveling coal, and this one never let me down."

name: Coal-Dusted Scarf

clues.text: Thick grey wool that itches just by looking at it.
Frayed at one end where a pipe once burned it.

story: "Warm as a boiler room," Bram says, wrapping it twice around his neck.

name: Boiler-Room Glove

clues.text: Dusted with fine black coal.
Stiff leather, soft only in the fingers.
A burn mark runs across the palm.

story: Bram flexes his fingers. "Left this on the footplate. Never found it. Till now."

name: Stuttering Pocket Watch

clues.text: Ticks, ticks, then skips a beat.
Gold-coloured, or very good gilt.
A neat star-shaped crack in the glass.

story: Odile smiles. "It keeps the time it likes. Like me, darling."

name: Gilt Opera Ticket

clues.text: Gold foil edges that flake onto your fingers.
Stamped: Grand Opera Halt, Box 4.

story: "My very last night on stage," Odile whispers. "I kept the ticket, not the applause."

name: Locket With Tiny Portrait

clues.text: Initials engraved inside: M.O.
Brass, worn bright by thumbs.
Closes with a soft, expensive click.

story: Odile opens it and goes quiet. "He had such a terrible moustache. I adored it."

name: Jar of Borrowed Fireflies

clues.text: A faint green glow flickers inside.
Thick glass with a bubble in the lid.
Everything inside is green-gold.

story: Pip beams. "They only want to be borrowed, not kept. I said thank you to each one."

name: Marble Jar

clues.text: Round and heavy, thick blue-tinted glass.
Rattles with three very serious marbles.

story: "My best three!" Pip counts them twice. "Nobody's allowed to win these."

name: Rain-Beaten Black Umbrella

clues.text: Black, or maybe navy in poor light.
Still faintly damp, even in the dry.
M.Q. burned into the handle.

story: The Inspector taps it twice. "Case of the missing umbrella: closed."

name: Leather Document Case

clues.text: Cracked leather with a brass clasp.
Stamped: Lost Property, Case 17.

story: "Inside," says Quill, "were my notes on this very station. Funny, that."

name: Pipe-Smoked Bowler Hat

clues.text: Smells of sweet pipe tobacco.
A thoughtful dent in the crown.

story: Quill settles it on his head. "Now I can think properly."

name: Heavy Iron Key

clues.text: Heavy, cold iron.
Tag reads: Vault 9, East Cellar.

story: Wren grins. "Opens the one door in this station nobody talks about."

name: Porter's Canvas Satchel

clues.text: Patched canvas, many times over.
Jingles with small brass fittings.

story: "Carried a thousand bags," Wren says. "This is the only one that's mine."

name: Left-Luggage Stub

clues.text: Stamped: Left Luggage, Shelf 3.
One corner torn clean off.

story: Wren laughs. "Forgot my own claim ticket. Don't tell the others."

name: Sea-Glass Knitted Scarf

clues.text: Blue? Green? Somewhere in between.
Hand-knit wool, a little lopsided.
One dropped stitch, left in on purpose.

story: Granny pats it. "First thing I ever knitted without crying."

name: Lavender Sachet

clues.text: Smells strongly of lavender.
Soft linen, hand-stitched.

story: "For the drawer, dear," Granny says. "And for bad dreams."

name: Tiny Blue Bootie

clues.text: Baby blue, knitted tight.
Just the one. A tiny pom-pom on top.

story: Granny's eyes glisten. "The other one is in my pocket. Always."

name: Dog-Eared Poetry Book

clues.text: Every other page folded down.
Smells of rain and library dust.
S.V. in faded ink on the flyleaf.

story: "Not damaged," Sorrel says. "Loved. There's a difference."

name: Bundle of Poem Drafts

clues.text: Old paper and a trace of rain.
Lines crossed out, then restored.

story: Sorrel clutches it. "Eleven drafts to get one line right. I think I got it."

name: Tortoiseshell Spectacles

clues.text: Amber-and-brown tortoiseshell frames.
One arm bent from being sat on.

story: "I can see again," Sorrel says. "And the world is still unfinished."

name: Stovepipe Hat

clues.text: Tall as a chimney, flat on top.
Hollow when you tap it, as if something sleeps inside.

story: Tobias lifts it. "Nothing up my sleeve. Everything in my hat."

name: Marked Deck of Cards

clues.text: Shuffles with a suspiciously smooth snap.
One ace has a tiny crescent on the back.

story: "Practice props," Tobias says, far too quickly.

name: Plain Gold Band

clues.text: Plain heavy gold, worn thin.
I.R. inside, in tiny script.

story: Lady Isolde exhales. "Three husbands. Only this one stayed."

name: The Green-Eyed Ring

clues.text: A green stone that catches light oddly.
Always a little cold to the touch.
Set in old, dark gold.

story: "Cursed?" Lady Isolde smiles. "Only if you're careless with it."

name: Crested Signet Ring

clues.text: A tiny raven crest, worn smooth.
Stamped inside: Ravenscroft Line.

story: "Family heirloom," she says. "Family trouble, mostly."

name: Wax-Sealed Letter

clues.text: Sealed with a thumbprint of red wax.
Smells of fresh ink.
Stamped: Express, Do Not Delay.

story: Ferris groans. "Three weeks late. I'll be delivering it on foot."

name: Punched Ticket

clues.text: Punched with a star-shaped hole.
Destination: Far Halt, Platform 12.

story: "A trip I wasn't going to take," Ferris says, and takes it anyway.

name: Ink-Smudged Envelope

clues.text: Blue ink bled right through.
F.C. scrawled on the back.

story: "My handwriting," Ferris sighs. "Even I can't read it."

name: Oil-Smelling Station Lantern

clues.text: Smells of lamp oil and warm brass.
A little hinged door, one hinge squeaking.

story: Mabel lights it. "The glow's right again. Welcome home."

name: Dented Tea Thermos

clues.text: Smells of strong, sweet tea.
Dented from one long, rolling fall.

story: "Still warm," Mabel says, wonderingly. "I don't ask how."

name: Jar of Spare Lens Glass

clues.text: Clinks like tiny bells.
Glass shards, all neatly sorted.

story: "For the day I mend the big lamp," Mabel says. "One day."

name: The Wandering Compass

clues.text: Needle points at something that isn't north.
Brass, polished by pockets.
A.Q. etched on the back.

story: "It's never wrong," Dr. Quimby says. "Just pointing at what I need."

name: Tintype of a Man and a Cat

clues.text: A tintype, silver and soft.
A very smug cat sits on his shoulder.

story: Dr. Quimby chuckles. "Statistically, the cat was the star."

name: Brass Pocket Barometer

clues.text: Brass dial, glass slightly fogged.
Tap it and the needle shivers.

story: "It says fair weather," says Dr. Quimby. "I don't trust it. I love it."

name: One-Eyed Rag Doll

clues.text: One button eye loose, one sewn tight.
Faded pink dress, patched twice.
Smells faintly of cocoa.

story: Juniper squeezes her. "Mr. Buttons says she's been very brave."

name: Tin Music Box

clues.text: Plays a slow lullaby, a note short.
The winding key is shaped like a star.

story: The tune starts. Juniper hums the missing note herself. "There. All better."

name: Wooden Platform Flute

clues.text: Warm pearwood, notched by a thumbnail.
A breathy, patient note.

story: Tam plays one phrase. A train somewhere slows to listen.

name: Single Left Shoe

clues.text: Smells of beeswax polish.
Resoled so many times it's mostly sole.

story: "A good shoe is a patient shoe," Tam says. "Where's the right? Walked off."

name: Coin From Nowhere

clues.text: No station on this coin's map, or any map.
One face shows a crescent, worn smooth.
Silver, cool as moonlight.

story: Zephyrine tilts it to the window. "Home, for a moment. Thank you."

name: Moonlight Silk Scarf

clues.text: Silk so light it barely weighs anything.
Silver-white, shifting like water.
Smells of cold air and a little lavender.

story: "Woven from a good night's sleep," Zephyrine says. "Don't tell the moon."
